title: DurabilityTools
description: DurabilityToolsTextures that warn you when your tools are about to break
body:
![Durability Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af9f41c3bcfcb9c78226deccc9d314cbc59d0188.png)# 🔨 DurabilityTools


How many times has a tool broken without you realising it?
**DurabilityTools** automatically changes the texture of your tools
when its battery life is low, giving you a clear visual warning
before it's too late.


> 📌 **Based on [Breaking Tools](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/breaking-tools)**,
> an original resource pack that only supports up to **1.20**.
> This version brings the same concept, updated for **1.21.x**
> with new textures and a contemporary design.


## ✨ Features
- Unique textures for tools with **low durability**
- Compatible with pick, shovel, axe, sword and hoe
- Works with **iron, gold, diamond and netherite** tools
- No mods required — just activate the resource pack
- **16x16** resolution, true to the vanilla style of Minecraft


## 📦 Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file
2. Place it in your `resourcepacks` folder
3. Enable it from **Options → Resource Packs**
4. ⚠️ Put it at the **top** of your list of resource packs


## 🎮 Compatibility
- Minecraft Java Edition **1.21.x**
